Explore LeftBlankFree & open source · macOS 14+ · Apple silicon
One space. Many ways to make.

More than words on a page.

Essays, equations, charts, presentation pages, diagrams and posters. Start with Typst, watch the result take shape, and share a finished PDF.

01Essays & everyday writing

Words, with room to breathe.

Shape an essay, a journal entry or your next chapter. Keep your outline nearby and see the page as you write.

02Equations & technical notes

Make a complex idea clear.

Bring equations, code and tables into one readable document. Typst keeps the details close to the thought.

03Charts & reports

Give your findings a form.

Turn observations into a visual report, with charts, tables and a PDF ready to share.

04Presentation pages

A good beginning for your next talk.

Compose landscape presentation pages in Typst. Set the rhythm, arrange the ideas and export your slides as a PDF.

05Diagrams & workflows

Let relationships take shape.

Use Typst packages such as CeTZ to draw the connections behind an idea, right beside the explanation.

06Posters & visual experiments

The page is part of the expression.

Explore geometry, color and type. Build a poster or a visual composition from the same writing space.

Real app captures. Original examples, ready to make your own.

Less in the way. More on the page.

A little room goes a long way.

01

Stay with the thought

A clean writing space, light or dark. Your outline waits in the margin. Your pages save as you go.

Focus, by design
02

Find the next possibility

Press ⌘J to discover what you can do. Find a table, an equation or a familiar action, and learn its shortcut as you go.

⌘ J
03

Begin somewhere interesting

Start with a blank page, a guided introduction or a template from the community. Explore a whole book, then make it your own.

⌘ N
04

Keep your words yours

Your writing lives in ordinary files on your Mac. Compare recent snapshots, return to an earlier draft, and export a finished PDF when you're ready.

A quiet corner of the web.

This website uses no analytics, advertising trackers or third-party fonts. Your language and appearance choices stay in your browser. Our hosting provider handles the network information needed to deliver the page. Links to GitHub take you to a separate service.
